_comment: Generic MCP registration for ANY client whose process runs on the same OS as
the build toolchain: native Linux, macOS, or a client installed inside WSL.
Replace REPO with the absolute repo path as the client process sees it.
Most clients take this object under a top-level key. Claude Desktop and
Claude Code call it mcpServers; others may call it servers or mcp.servers.
The three inner fields (command, args, env) are the part that is standard.
No cwd is set and none is needed. sotn_cmd_mcp.py puts its own directory on
sys.path and commands_client.py derives the repo root from the file location.
SOTN_CMD_DRYRUN fails closed: unset or empty means dry-run. Leave it at 1,
call list_allowed, read the argv a few tools produce, then set it to 0.
